title: Kamailio World Online 2020 – The Schedule
html:
The schedule for Kamailio World Updates – an online event during Sep 2-3, 2020 – has been published on event website:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k08-online/

Presentations, live demos, open discussions and the celebration party for 19 years of Kamailio development! Two half days of knowledge sharing and community networking!

The event will be streamed live on KamailioWorld Youtube channel:

  • https://www.youtube.com/c/KamailioWorld/

The participants will be able to interact via video conferencing room and text chatting channel. The specific details will be published soon!

No registration is needed! Just join us using an WebRTC-capable browser!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
